nodes.title: 01 WIDE camera op
widgets_values: A sunny East Village walk up apartment with a red brick wall and a green velvet couch | relaxing on the couch, smiling to themselves

Wide establishing shot. Shot on an iPhone held in someone's hands: gentle breathing float, small drifting reframes, natural motion blur on movement, the focus softly shifting between subject and background, auto exposure gently breathing. Real iPhone video look, natural light, no cinematic grade. The camera holds this framing: one single continuous take, no big zooms, no pull backs, no cuts to another place. Same characters, same wardrobe, same location and same view out of the windows as the first frame. Natural, subtle performance: small breaths, tiny shifts of the eyes and head, a slight change of expression at most, no big smiles, no exaggerated faces, no talking. Rules: every person appears only once, no duplicates, no twins, no extra people. Natural human anatomy, two hands with five fingers, true to life scale between people and objects. Hands stay relaxed and empty unless the moment needs them. No text, no logos, no watermarks. No morphing faces, no melting objects.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: Egyptian royal in blue-and-gold headdress and high collar, white dress with golden embroidery and armbands, desert, robot soldiers in formation left and right. She walks steadily forward, head held level and gaze fixed ahead—no dipping or lowering of the head. The camera performs a single, smooth push-in only: starting in a wider shot of her, the robots, and the desert, it moves steadily forward until she is in a medium or medium-close frame, then holds. She stops, posture and head still upright, and says: “The old gods are silent. I am not.” Robot soldiers shift or march in place; sand and fabric move with the wind. No pull-back; the only camera move is the continuous push-in.
